plugins.name: finding-unknowns
plugins.description: One task card per task: you predict first and answer only what only you can decide, the agent builds quietly and stops only at four checkable points (irreversible step, scope change, dead premise, budget), and the completion report grades every frozen prediction. /fu-brief, /fu-catch-up, /fu-debrief, /fu-view. A deterministic fu script lints, freezes and checks the card, keeps the prediction log and renders an optional HTML view; a strict profile serves small models. Measured results use Theory → Measured → Consistent? → Mechanism. One agent, mechanism-auditor, used narrowly. Structured mode and the classic line live on branch v4. Whether this helps people is not yet tested.
